title: The Goblin Bakery
pitch: Grub's secret pie recipe is gone and everyone is a suspect.

title: The Necromancer's Job Interview
pitch: One job, three undead applicants, one very pompous boss.

title: The Goblin Construction Crew
pitch: Wall in the treasure before the knight arrives. They build, they dig, they argue.

title: The Dragon's Tax Audit
pitch: A terrified tax collector, a dragon who owes 3,000 years, a squire with a wooden sword.

title: The Haunted Tavern
pitch: The ghost wants respect. The innkeeper blames the pipes. The knight thinks she's his ex-wife.

title: The Oracle
pitch: He knows everything. He runs on a 490 MB brain. Ask him anything.

title: The Greenwood
pitch: Woods, a hunters' camp, a hermit's hut, old ruins with a wolf in them, and a lost silver horn.

title: Millbrook Farm
pitch: Cows, horses, a dog and a pig, and one cow missing. The farmer pays in pie.

title: The Crystal Caves
pitch: Glowing caverns, snakes in the dark, a wyrmling asleep on the miners' gold.
